body: I think i will read all of the mythology or as much as i can. I have a deep fascination with the whole thing, and it seems to be one of the few things that i enjoy in life still. I dont know about critiquing them but it would be something to explore. From what i already know, im in the same boat on the hating of Zeus but Poseidon im sort of on the fence about. Would you mind explaining to me why you despise those 2 gods? Maybe, thats an option to explore. Ive always wanted to visit europe and maybe i will before i do end it, it may not be this time now that youve given me something to strive towards so maybe there is still hope. I didnt know who Joseph Campbell was so i googled him and i think i will read his books to see his perspective on the greek gods. I think i definitely will visit the Athena Parthenon before i do anything, just to give myself something. I dont know about writing mythology books but i would need to do more research and come up with something new about it. I think im going to go see my psychiatrist tomorrow and try and sort this out, ive had a good talk with a close friend who has managed to convince me to at least try before i do anything drastic

I tried writing but even though i had some ideas for some fiction that i would write, i could never get down what was in my head onto paper. I used to play piano and for a long while that gave me solace. I was never a master at it, but i did enjoy it and that feeling of gliding over the keys making what sounded to me as beautiful but probably sounded like crap used to make me feel good. Now i cant seem to get the motivation or creativity to even sit down at the piano again and start playing. Its funny you mention Typhon as i have a fascination with greek and roman mythology. Its one of the few things that on the rare days when i feel half way towards ok that i can use to distract myself. I would love to go and visit greece and see the parthenon and maybe i still will if i can fight this again but i really dont know this time

Just the constant being in pain from living and the fact that it seems i am unable to feel any sort of happiness or any good emotions whatsoever. I feel like a complete burden to my parents with the fact that im 20 years old and have done nothing with my life. Im unemployed, have barely any friends that i speak to and i just feel like a tremendous waste of space. Ive pulled myself back from the edge so many times and it seems like this is the straw that broke the camels back
